project_context: TikTok LIVE interactive battle arena (9:16 vertical broadcast format) featuring animated fighters (Lula vs Flávio) with serialized gift processing pipeline, audio triggers, and dynamic canvas-rendered special cinematic moves (Invocadores & Genkidama).

entry_surfaces./: split live arena — left/center 9:16 interactive vertical arena canvas and fighter stage, right quick gift trigger panel, admin configuration modal, combat log and real-time audio controls

motion.reduced_motion: Disable screen shakes, replace particle explosion with instant animated radial ring fade

genkidama_explosion.description: Som de explosão impact audio triggered right when the Genkidama hits the target and shatters the ground

lula_special_voice_a.description: Lula special voice line option A - alternates randomly without immediate repetition with voice line option B

flavio_special_voice.description: Flávio special voice line used on all Flávio special moves

Reference for fighter levitation, energy gathering particles, and Genkidama orb glow effect
Reference for arena destructive impact, crater debris, radial shockwave rings, and combat visual effects

accessibility.data_testids: All buttons, gift senders, audio toggles, character selectors, and admin inputs must provide strict role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='trigger-gift-martelo-btn', data-testid='trigger-gift-galaxia-btn', data-testid='admin-settings-dialog-trigger')
accessibility.sound_controls: Global volume control, Mute toggle, and visual subtitle/toast notifications when audio lines fire

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Preserve the 9:16 vertical TikTok LIVE broadcast container as the central focus while providing live stream controls, gift simulation panels, and real-time combat telemetry.
2. Implement the full canvas and particle animation for Invocadores: ground slam, summoning the robed hammer warrior, multi-hit strike combo, flying rocks, and tremor.

3. Implement the full canvas and particle animation for Genkidama: levitation, celestial light gathering, massive glowing energy sphere, dramatic launch, destructive impact, crater fissures, and debris.

4. Connect audio assets accurately: Play Genkidama charge sound during buildup and explosion sound upon impact. For Lula, alternate between voice lines without consecutive duplicates. For Flávio, trigger the dedicated voice line on all specials.
5. Register configurable gifts: Martelo triggers Invocadores (150 damage) and Galáxia triggers Genkidama (300 damage), with full admin customization capabilities.
6. Maintain strict serialized FIFO gift pipeline so specials and incoming gifts queue and execute cleanly without collision or state corruption.
